note: [agent-bulk] nuecc. Vertex judged from the native r95 framing (event_half_span_cm 79.0, no re-capture needed): on vtx-az+065-el+20 the blue star sits exactly on the kink where the big shower leaves and a single orange track runs off the other way - a clean two-prong vertex, and the shower start X sits on it. Not a vertex failure. shw 21048 (521.9 MeV, 13 seg, pdg 11, len 99.8) is the most textbook electron in my shard: one apex at the X, a straight narrow MIP stem for the first ~15 cm, then a wide multi-branch fan, and the same shape holds on both az-055 and az+085 so it is not a projection artefact. All 13 members lie inside 48.7 cm and 15.4 deg; the yellow set covers the whole visible fan with no gap. Nothing contiguous is missing: the only unowned segments inside 30 deg are 63056 (0.8 cm, 57.3 cm / 26.6 deg) and 61054 (0.6 cm, 85.8 cm / 29.9 deg), both negligible. The two real neighbours are correctly left out - cluster 64 (shower 64059, 22.3 MeV, 17.4 cm over three segments) at 48-53 cm / 33.5-39.5 deg, and 65061 (pdg 2212, 7.9 cm, kine_best 100.9 MeV) at 62.2 cm / 46.8 deg - both far outside the cone for a shower whose members stop at 15 deg. Second object worth naming: shw 21063 (kine_charge 171.8 MeV, 3 seg, 31.1 cm) reads dist 0.0 / angle 0.0 against 21048, i.e. it starts on the SAME vertex point, and runs out at 110.9-123.3 deg from 21048's axis - the long thin orange prong on the other side of the star. The reconstruction kept them as two separate showers and I think that is right (backwards of the axis is not the same cone), but a 171.8 MeV vertex-attached pdg-11 object with a 31 cm straight body is a track/PID question I am not resolving here. pi0: showers[].pio_id is -1 for every shower and the reconstruction accepted NO group. The capture's auto-slotted top-two pair (21048 + 21063) is the placeholder, not a reco pairing, and pricing it gives theta 113.9 deg -> m = 502.0 MeV, plus both gammas share the vertex as their start so neither can be a conversion; I store no candidate. Clustering statement, silent on PID. Not looked at: the 6 showers the scope rule skipped (58051, 27049, 57050, 61054, 63056, 60053), all under 20 MeV min_kine_best; of the 4 in scope I opened frames for 21048 only and read 21063, 65061 and 64059 off the candidate table.
